sj-0LmF.title: Coverage: boat with wooden deck
sj-0LmF.summary: A boat with a wooden deck, seen in several places.

sj-76Dm.title: Coverage: small red boat, red jackets
sj-76Dm.summary: A small red boat with men in red jackets, seen in the northwest.

sj-B7RJ.title: Landscape: road between mountains and lakes
sj-B7RJ.summary: A road southeast of the largest settlement, with barren treeless mountains on both sides and lakes in front of them. A small black mirror may show on the left.

sj-Hxz3.title: Language: some Russian on signs
sj-Hxz3.summary: Russian can sometimes be seen on signs.

sj-OD81.title: Coverage: boat with black deck
sj-OD81.summary: A boat with a black deck, seen in a fjord between two of the towns.

sj-TJmr.title: Coverage: Arctic archipelago
sj-TJmr.summary: An archipelago in the Arctic Ocean under Norwegian sovereignty, so it counts as Norway for streaks.

sj-V6YU.title: Plate: black with yellow text
sj-V6YU.summary: Licence plates are generally black with yellow text.

sj-ZiYY.title: Coverage: trekker holding a red car
sj-ZiYY.summary: A trekker holds on to a red car going up a winding road south of the airport. Without the car, a distinct line of mountains to the northeast shows you are there.

sj-igav.title: Houses: boxy minimalist buildings
sj-igav.summary: The largest settlement has lots of boxy, minimalistic buildings.

sj-oo8W.title: Coverage: boat, slanted wheelhouse front
sj-oo8W.summary: A boat east of the Soviet-style town, recognised by the slanted front of its wheelhouse.

sj-pmRN.title: Landscape: barren treeless mountains, gloomy
sj-pmRN.summary: Barren mountains without trees, with mostly moss and grass. The sky is often overcast and the coverage looks gloomy.

sj-pqGg.title: Houses: multi-coloured apartment blocks
sj-pqGg.summary: The most desolate of the three towns. Distinct multi-coloured apartment blocks stand near the top of a hill, and the coverage is more overcast and gloomy than the others.

sj-ujEh.title: Coverage: large ship, gets darker eastward
sj-ujEh.summary: A large ship around a national park in the northwest. Coverage gets later in the day the further east you go, until it turns dark.

sj-ywbM.title: Houses: Soviet blocks, abandoned feel
sj-ywbM.summary: An abandoned-feeling town with multi-storey Soviet-style apartment blocks and little human activity. Many pyramid-shaped mountains stand in the distance.
